question: Whose declared opinion is this?
premises: bṛhacchīkramatantrasya means of the bṛhacchīkrama tantra
inference: this is the declared opinion of the bṛhacchīkrama tantra
uncertainties: whether udīritam is passive or active is unclear
plain_english: This is the declared opinion of the Bṛhacchīkrama Tantra.
